blind.second_guess: bench with leg rest or restraints
blind.description: A set of medieval wooden stocks constructed from warm brown planks and timber posts with iron hinges and a padlock. It features two upright side posts with beveled caps, resting on floor feet with angled knee braces. Between the posts are two horizontal boards split horizontally with four circular holes cut along the seam (for legs/wrists/head), secured with dark iron strap hinges on one side and an iron latch with a hanging padlock on the other. A horizontal wooden bench or footrest plank extends along the front near ground level, supported by central and side blocks. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully textured with natural wood grain and matte iron fittings.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated rectangle consisting of a narrower top beam parallel to a wider horizontal plank/seat, framed on both ends by square post caps and rectangular base feet extending outward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide across the base.
